name: Kritik
summary: Kritik is a peer assessment and authorship platform for higher education. Instructors create activities where students submit work, evaluate each other's work against a rubric, and give feedback on the evaluations they receive. Authorship tracking shows how a student's writing developed, including their use of AI, so instructors can assess process as well as product.

areas.name: Activity creation
areas.description: Instructors set up activities: type, rubric, schedule, groups, authorship settings, AI-assisted creation.

areas.name: Submitting work
areas.description: Students write or upload their creation, use the AI assistant, and submit before the deadline.

areas.name: Peer evaluation
areas.description: Students evaluate assigned peers' work with the rubric and written comments.

areas.name: Feedback
areas.description: Students rate the evaluations they received; instructors see flagged evaluations and disputes.

areas.name: Authorship and AI use
areas.description: Writing replay, AI usage reports and authorship scores instructors use to understand how work was produced.

areas.name: Grading and scores
areas.description: Creation, evaluation and feedback scores, grade calculation, exports and LMS grade sync.

areas.name: Course management
areas.description: Rosters, LMS integrations, notifications, accounts and settings.
